hero.title: Homework Assistance
hero.lead: After school support that runs in parallel with the school year.

intro.lead: Our after school homework assistance program runs from August through mid-June, following the school calendar so students have support on every day they have work due.
intro.body: Sessions are one-on-one and can be taken in person at our San Gabriel campus or online from home.
ticks: August through mid-June, parallel to the school year
intro.imageAlt: Students completing homework with instructor support
